title: Give OLY-2-15 (Dionysus exploration) a bounded-experiment mechanism
summary: Add a small athena-core module, exploration.rs, that models a Dionysus bounded experiment (hypothesis, unconventional approach, hard bound) and refuses unbounded or empty ones. Then record it as OLY-2-15's mechanism and measure in docs/spec.toml, with a test that fails without it. Audience: the Hestia spec review and the verifier.

defaults_applied.how: New module has unit tests; fmt, clippy and test criteria included.
The criterion runs the tests that exercise refusal and acceptance.
No existing crate fits; plain Rust, recorded as a design call.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: Code survey: read crates/athena-core/src/status.rs (STATUS_MEASURE_LABELS, the allowed `status:` labels), crates/athena-core/src/hestia.rs (spec review, parse_spec, SPEC_FILE, and the test that parses include_str!(docs/spec.toml)), and crates/athena-core/src/proposals.rs (an existing record-backed proposal flow). No code mentions experiments yet. The change adds no record or data file under crates/, so check_record_file, AnyRecord and the round-trip test are not touched.

Existing code: extends crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs (module list) and follows the style of crates/athena-core/src/manage.rs and crates/athena-core/src/proposals.rs; docs/spec.toml holds the requirement entry.
Design call: no printed status label fits exploration, so the measure ends with `status: not shown` and names the test. Adding a status line is out of scope to keep the change small.
Design call: a pure-code module, with no language-model role and no new crate (buy-first: nothing off the shelf models this). Not a new refusal rule on readings, so no refusal-rate criterion applies.
Goal: Dionysus's exploration duty gets a checkable mechanism; the audience is the Hestia spec review and the verifier.

acceptance_criteria.text: docs/spec.toml entry OLY-2-15 has a mechanism naming crates/athena-core/src/exploration.rs (not "none"), keeps owner "Dionysus", and a measure ending with `status: not shown` that names the test (cargo test -p athena-core exploration). Check with Grep on docs/spec.toml.

crates/athena-core/src/exploration.rs exists, is declared in crates/athena-core/src/lib.rs, and defines a bounded-experiment type (hypothesis, unconventional approach, bound, outcome) with a validate function.

Run `cargo test -p athena-core exploration`: tests show that an experiment with no bound or an empty hypothesis is refused, that a bounded one is accepted, and that an experiment which exceeds its bound is reported as stopped. Each test fails if validate is stubbed to accept everything.
Run `cargo fmt --check`, `cargo clippy --all-targets` and `cargo test`: all pass. This includes the existing spec tests in hestia.rs and xtask that parse docs/spec.toml.

out_of_scope: A new language-model Dionysus role or prompt
Changes to other requirements in docs/spec.toml
